# Reading like a regular user, checking what readers complain about most in other apps:
# losing your place, rotation jumping pages, zoom turning the page, and the hop to the next chapter.
# Runs after 30_showcase, which installs Webtoons.com and MangaDex and adds a series from each.

# Long strip (Webtoons.com)
start app.kurotoon.dev
tapx Browse
tapx Sources
tap Webtoons.com
sleep 12
tapxy 270 1000
sleep 12
shot strip_series
tapif Resume
tapif Start
sleep 20
shot strip_open
scrollup
scrollup
scrollup
sleep 2
shot strip_scrolled
scrollup
scrollup
scrollup
sleep 3
shot strip_scrolled_more
# Menu over the page, then hide it again
tapxy 540 1200
sleep 2
shot strip_menu
tapxy 540 1200
sleep 1
# Leave mid-chapter and come back: should land on the same panel
back
sleep 3
shot strip_back_on_series
tapif Resume
sleep 15
shot strip_resumed
# Turning the phone must not move you
rotate 1
sleep 5
shot strip_landscape
rotate 0
sleep 5
shot strip_portrait_again
# Kill the app; Home should offer this chapter and reopen it in place
stop app.kurotoon.dev
start app.kurotoon.dev
sleep 8
shot home_after_kill
tapif Resume
sleep 15
shot strip_after_kill
# Fling to the end of the chapter and on to the next one
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
sleep 3
shot strip_end
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
swipe 540 1900 540 300 80
sleep 8
shot strip_next_chapter
tapxy 540 1200
sleep 2
shot strip_next_menu
tap Chapters
sleep 3
shot strip_chapter_list
back
sleep 1
back
sleep 3
shot strip_series_after
back
sleep 2
back
sleep 2

# Paged (MangaDex)
start app.kurotoon.dev
tapx Browse
tapx Sources
tap MangaDex
sleep 12
tapxy 270 1000
sleep 12
shot paged_series
tapif Resume
tapif Start
sleep 20
shot paged_open
swipe 900 1200 150 1200 150
sleep 3
shot paged_swipe_left
swipe 150 1200 900 1200 150
sleep 3
shot paged_swipe_right
# Double-tap to zoom, then pan: the page must stay put while zoomed
sh "input tap 540 1100; input tap 540 1100"
sleep 2
shot paged_zoomed
swipe 700 1200 400 1200 300
sleep 2
shot paged_zoomed_pan
sh "input tap 540 1100; input tap 540 1100"
sleep 2
shot paged_unzoomed
# Rotate on a page
rotate 1
sleep 5
shot paged_landscape
rotate 0
sleep 5
shot paged_portrait_again
# Reader settings sheet
tapxy 540 1200
sleep 2
tap Settings
sleep 3
shot paged_settings
scrollup
shot paged_settings_more
back
sleep 2
back
sleep 3
shot paged_back_on_series
back
sleep 2
back
sleep 2

# Afterwards: History and Home reflect what was read
start app.kurotoon.dev
tapx Home
sleep 6
shot home_after_reading
tapif History
sleep 3
shot history_after_reading
